votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of July 9, 2024, and the formal meeting minutes of June 11, 2024 and July 2, 2024.
votes.description: The Council approved three sets of prior meeting minutes: the July 9, 2024 work session minutes and the June 11, 2024 and July 2, 2024 formal meeting minutes.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on items B1 and B2 (Zoning Text Amendment to the D-1 Central Business District Zone and Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 754 South State Street) and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed rezoning and zoning text amendment related to the former Sears site at 754 South State Street and deferred final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close and refer item B-3 (FY2024 Paul Coverdell Forensic Science Improvement Competitive Grant) to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the Police Department's grant application to the U.S. DOJ Bureau of Justice Assistance and referred it to a future consent agenda for formal approval.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 27 of 2024, adopting the Capital Improvement Program project-specific allocations for fiscal year 2025 as shown on the attached Exhibits A Funding Log.
votes.description: The Council adopted Resolution 27 of 2024 approving the specific project funding allocations for the FY2025 Capital Improvement Program, which covers construction, purchase, or renovation of city-owned physical structures.

votes.motion: Defer action on the ordinance to vacate a portion of 700 South to a future date.
votes.description: The Council deferred action on the proposed street vacation of a portion of 700 South adjacent to 717 South 5600 West to a future meeting in order to resolve concerns raised by Public Utilities regarding easement access.

votes.motion: Reconsider the previous motion to defer action on the ordinance to vacate a portion of 700 South.
votes.description: The Council voted to reconsider its earlier motion to defer action on the 700 South street vacation ordinance, allowing the matter to be taken up again in the same meeting.

votes.motion: Reject the ordinance to vacate a portion of 700 South adjacent to 717 South 5600 West.
votes.description: The Council rejected the proposed ordinance to vacate a portion of 700 South, primarily due to Public Utilities' concerns and opposition regarding easement access and continued maintenance of the area.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 64 of 2024 (Projecting Business Signs Zoning Text Amendment).
votes.description: The Council adopted Ordinance 64 of 2024 amending Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to create consistency and update standards for projecting business signs in commercial and mixed-use districts.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 65 of 2024 (Zoning Text Amendment to Allow Single-Family Attached Dwellings in Select Commercial Zones).
votes.description: The Council adopted Ordinance 65 of 2024 amending Title 21A to allow single-family attached dwellings in select commercial zones where multifamily dwellings are already permitted, including CB, CS, CC, CG, and CSHBD 1 & 2 districts.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 63 of 2024 (Sports, Entertainment, Culture, and Convention District Text Amendment).
votes.description: The Council adopted Ordinance 63 of 2024 amending the D4 Secondary Central Business District zoning to support creation of a Sports, Entertainment, Culture, and Convention (SECC) district, including changes to height limits, setbacks, permitted uses, and sign overlay.

votes.motion: Approve and celebrate Jennifer Bruno as the new Salt Lake City Council Executive Director.
votes.description: The Council approved the appointment of Jennifer Bruno as the Salt Lake City Council Executive Director.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda and defer action on the Sister Cities Advisory Board appointment of Jane Kim.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items including setting a public hearing date for the parking demolition text amendment and the appointment of Steven Burt to the City and County Building Conservation and Use Committee, while deferring the Sister Cities Advisory Board appointment of Jane Kim to a future meeting.
